description: Modules that hold an SVG sink and must sit behind the sanitiser they are paired with
rule: An SVG sink is a module that calls unsafeSVG, value-imports an SVG sanitiser, creates a Blob of type image/svg+xml, or is listed here. The sanitisers are src/icons/svg-sanitize.ts and src/svg-image/sanitize.ts (library images). A sink is paired with the sanitiser it value-imports, else the one listed here for it, else svg-sanitize. The paired sanitiser is statically imported in every chunk that holds the sink, or in a chunk on every chain of parent chunks from magic-card.js to it; never only in a sibling or behind its own import(). tools/check-svg-sinks.mjs finds sinks by scanning src and adds the modules below. Every kind of value import counts (import, bare import, export … from, import()). src/svg-safety is value-imported only by the two sanitisers and by itself, except css-loader.ts, which the files of SVG_CSS_OPEN_SITES (src/contracts/svg-safety.ts) may also value-import; a chunk that holds one of its modules holds a sanitiser, except the svg-css chunk (the CSS paint resolver, which holds no sink and no sanitiser) and a chunk whose only svg-safety module is css-loader.ts.
